# Talata Basketball

> Basketball club in Copenhagen, Østerbro. Ages 5 to adult, since 2021. Your first session is free.

Talata Basketball is a registered Danish forening (CVR 43599453) on Østerbro in Copenhagen. We run year-round programs for children and adults, teams in the Danish national leagues (DBBF), and camps in the school holidays. Member of DBBF and DGI. More than 100 playing members across the club (September 2026).

Last updated: 2026-10-06. Season 26/27 started Monday 10 August 2026.

## Programs and training times (season 26/27)

Times below come straight from the club's training schedule. A session marked "from" a date starts that day.

A 12-year-old is Junior at <!--fact:facts.program.junior.fee|kr-->1.800 kr<!--/fact-->, not Academy at <!--fact:facts.program.academy.fee|kr-->3.300 kr<!--/fact-->, unless the family specifically asks for Academy. Competition brackets are a separate thing from these club groups: DBBF brackets go on a player's age on 1 October, so a player who turns 15 in November is still U15 for that season.
- [Talata Men](https://talatabasketball.dk/men), competitive, 18+: <!--fact:teams.men|sched-->Mon 18:45 to 20:15 at Svanemøllehallen, Tue 18:45 to 20:00 at Svanemøllehallen, Fri 18:45 to 21:00 at Nørre Fælled Skole from 23 Oct<!--/fact-->. <!--fact:facts.program.men_competitive.fee|kr-->2.000 kr<!--/fact--> per half-season. Plays DBBF 3. Division Øst.
- Talata Fitness Men, recreational, 18+: same evening slots and same halls as Talata Men, no league commitment. <!--fact:facts.program.fitness_men.fee|kr-->2.000 kr<!--/fact--> per half-season.
- [Girls 15 and up](https://talatabasketball.dk/sparks#girls-15): the Stevnsgade girls team (KU17 and KU19), coached by Deng Awak. <!--fact:teams.girls_15|sched-->Mon + Wed + Fri 17:30 to 19:00 at Nørrebrohallen<!--/fact-->, Nørrebrogade 208, 2200 København N. The team plays the KU17 league with home games at Nørrebrohallen. First session free, just come and ask for Coach Deng. Enrolment after that goes through Stevnsgade. Every girl aged 15 and up trains here, not in the Academy sessions.

Fees are charged per half-season, not per month and not per session. One fee covers every session that group trains. Sibling discounts are available on request, and the club has routes for families where cost is the barrier.

## Coaches and player pathway

- School partnerships: Strandvejsskolen (Mini and Junior, Sionsgade 1, Oesterbro) and ISH, the International School of Hellerup (High School, Thursdays at Svanemoellehallen), run in collaboration with DGI. From 2019 to 2024 head coach Deng Awak was head of the basketball academy at The British School of Vilnius in Lithuania, where he built the programme from the youngest children up to the mid-teens. That programme is not running through Talata today.
- [Coaches](https://talatabasketball.dk/coaches): Deng Awak (head coach, played pro in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark, coached in four countries), Jordan Naughton (head of academy, lead assistant coach U15, NCAA Division 1 at University of Wyoming, pro with BK Amager), Georg Jespersen (head coach U15, U13 and U9, lead coach Mini and Junior, played youth basketball at Falcon, studying sustainability at Copenhagen Business School), James Young (assistant coach, Chowan University, eight years pro in Denmark).
- [Saturday sessions](https://talatabasketball.dk/saturday): NEW for 2026/27, live from Sat 3 Oct 2026. Kulturhuset Indre By, Charlotte Ammundsens Plads 3, 1359 Copenhagen K. Mini (ages 5 to 9) <!--fact:teams.mini|sat-->10:00 to 11:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By<!--/fact--> and Junior (ages 10 to 12) <!--fact:teams.junior|sat-->11:00 to 12:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By<!--/fact-->, back to back so a family with two children makes one trip. Family Time for kids and parents together follows, <!--fact:teams.family_time|sat-->12:00 to 13:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By<!--/fact-->. Built for families where weekday afternoon sessions do not work. First session free. Register interest at coach@talatabasketball.dk.
- [Player placement](https://talatabasketball.dk/placement): Talata's placement service. Routes are high school and prep in the USA and Canada, clubs and academies in Europe including Spain, and college (NCAA, NAIA, JUCO). Representation goes through FIBA licensed agents. The first conversation and the evaluation are free. Two players named publicly: Malthe Mikkelsen joined the Talata Academy for the year and Talata ran the placement process with him to Orangeville Prep (Canada, 2025/26). Johan Lyager Joensen came up through the club from its first season and went to Martins Ferry High School (Ohio, USA, 2026/27); Talata developed him but his family handled that move. Contact coach@talatabasketball.dk. NIL advice from 2027.
- [Player pathway](https://talatabasketball.dk/pathway): Malthe Mikkelsen went to Orangeville Prep in Canada for 2025/26. Johan Lyager Joensen leaves for Martins Ferry High School in Ohio, USA (the Purple Riders), in 2026/27. Marius Wriedt moved from Talata Men to Naestved in the 1. division.

## Games and results

Every home game is free to watch. No ticket, no entry fee, turn up.

- [Fixtures and results](https://talatabasketball.dk/games): the full season, kept in step with the Danish Basketball Federation (DBBF) export and Holdsport.
- Six teams play league basketball in season 26/27: Talata Men in 3. Division East, U19 in U19 1st Division East, U15 in U15 Championship East, U13 in U13 Championship East, a second U13 team in U13 Grand Prix East, and U9 in U9 Grand Prix East. 59 fixtures in total.
- Home venues: Svanemøllehallen on Østerbro and Nørre Fælled Skole on Nørrebro, both in Copenhagen.
- Danish Cup 1/16 final: Talata Men beat Hørsholm 78 to 67 at Svanemøllehallen on 7 September 2026. DBBF annulled that result on protest on 11 September. Talata won the replay 89 to 87 after overtime at Rungsted Skole on 14 September 2026. Deng Awak scored 34, Jordan Naughton 21. The run ended in the 1/8 final, away at BK Amager on 22 September 2026, 93 to 79.

## Camps

Open for booking now:

All three run at Hafnia-Hallen, Julius Andersensvej 6, 2450 Copenhagen SV. In week 42 both October camps run Monday 12 to Thursday 15 October, four days each, in the same hall at the same time. Tuesday 13 October is a full camp day too, with court time in the morning and the afternoon and a session upstairs in the middle of the day. On Thursday Academy U15 Camp starts at 10:00, and from 12:30 every age group plays games together. Academy U12 Camp comes on Thursday for the games only, from 12:30. A hot buffet lunch, snacks and fruit are included, so families do not pack lunch.

- [Academy U12 Camp](https://talatabasketball.dk/camps/academy-u12-camp-2026): Monday 12 to Thursday 15 October 2026, four days, Hafnia-Hallen, Copenhagen SV. Ages 5 to 11, 09:30 to 14:30 Monday to Wednesday, Thursday game day 12:30 to 14:30, 35 places. Snacks and fruit included, hot buffet lunch Monday to Wednesday included. <!--fact:camps.starter.price_now|kr-->1.395 kr<!--/fact-->.
- [Academy U15 Camp](https://talatabasketball.dk/camps/academy-u15-camp-2026): Monday 12 to Thursday 15 October 2026, four days, Hafnia-Hallen, Copenhagen SV. Ages 12 to 16, 09:30 to 14:30, Thursday starts 10:00, 25 places. Snacks and fruit included, hot buffet lunch all four days included. <!--fact:camps.academy.price_now|kr-->1.595 kr<!--/fact-->. It runs in the same hall at the same time as Academy U12 Camp Monday to Wednesday, so a family with two children has one drop off and one pick up, and on Thursday afternoon the two camps play together.
- [International Academy and College Pathway Camp](https://talatabasketball.dk/camps/college-pathway-camp-2026): Monday 28 to Wednesday 30 December 2026, Hafnia-Hallen, Copenhagen SV. Ages 13 to 17, 09:00 to 14:00, 16 places. <!--fact:camps.pathway|priceline-->1.295 kr to Sunday 1 November, then 1.495 kr<!--/fact-->. Three days on what playing basketball in America takes: measured profile, filmed live play, game day. Players leave with their numbers, full game film, a highlight clip and a written evaluation.

## Joining

The first session is always free, for every program and every age. No experience and no gear needed, just indoor trainers and a water bottle. Balls are provided. New players are welcome all year and the fee is prorated if you join mid-season.

Book a free session: https://talatabasketball.dk/join
Guide to basketball in Copenhagen, including other clubs: https://talatabasketball.dk/basketball-in-copenhagen
Every hall, its address and who trains there: https://talatabasketball.dk/where-we-train
For English-speaking families (we coach in English and Danish): https://talatabasketball.dk/english-speaking-basketball-copenhagen

## Coaching philosophy

Talata runs a Constraints-Led Approach (CLA), which is ecological dynamics applied to basketball. Skill emerges from the interaction of Task, Environment and Individual. Sessions use small-sided games and game-like problems. No block practice, no form cues, no lines, no over-coaching.

Five pillars: Bamboo Mindset, Repetition Without Repetition, Lag-Free Excellence, Autonomy and Discovery, Representative Integrity.

Full philosophy: https://talatabasketball.dk/philosophy
